Name: Game and RCON Port
Description: UDP port for game traffic. The remote console (RCON) listens on the same port number over TCP

Name: Server Browser Port
Description: Port that the server browser queries to list this server. Project Reclaimer 0.10 uses it over both TCP and UDP

Name: LAN Discovery Port
Description: UDP port where the server answers the in-game Server Browser's search of the local network, so players on the same network find it without the public server list. The server always uses 44329: keep this port at 44329. Multiple instances can answer to this shared port
